text:
Maya Lin: Heads-up — FastLane Retail wants a 3-week POC. Requirements: streaming product tagger (low latency), nightly bulk embeddings for similarity search, and a tool-call to their pricing microservice. They also asked for a cost estimate for ~10M tokens/month and SOC2/KMS answers.

Owen Park: Hosted is fine for POC per buyer, but they may want Dedicated if latency tests look good. Can we offer time-limited Dedicated?

Nate (DevOps): Yes, we can provision a temporary Dedicated pool (2 GPUs) for the trial, but need 48-72h lead time and a signed trial agreement. KMS-backed keys supported; we'll need the customer's key ARN for setup.

Rina Gupta: Pricing ballpark — hosted gen + embeddings for 10M tokens comes to ~USD 1.2k–2.5k depending on model mix and embedding volume. I'll request a formal quote from finance.

Maya Lin: FastLane security team will send questionnaire. Can someone prepare a short Q&A: SOC2 status, data retention, PII handling, encryption at rest, IP allowlist?

sec-bot: Auto: SOC2 Type II report available after NDA. We support customer-managed KMS, TLS in transit, and configurable log retention (default 30 days). IP allowlist and VPC peering available for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Owen Park: For integration, share a minimal streaming + tool-call example they can drop into their service. They want final output as a JSON object with fields: product_id, category, confidence, tags[], price.{value,currency,source}.

Owen Park: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="<REDACTED>")

# streaming classify + tool-call (price)
with client.stream('classify', model='redwood-gen-3') as stream:
    stream.send({"text": "Item: \"Banana Organic Bunch\"", "schema": "catalog_item", "tool_calls": ["price_service"]})
    for evt in stream.iter_chunks():
        print(evt.text)
```

Maya Lin: Also include an example of the final JSON payload we emit. They need deterministic schema for ETL.

Nate (DevOps): We'll validate schema server-side and can fail / emit diagnostics if shape mismatches. Example final payload below.

Owen Park: ```json
{
  "product_id": "BNN-ORG-001",
  "category": "produce/fruit",
  "confidence": 0.97,
  "tags": ["organic","local"],
  "price": {"value": 0.89, "currency": "USD", "source": "price_service_v2"}
}
```

Rina Gupta: Note: we support schema validation and redaction hooks. Default log retention 30 days; can be changed contractually. PII can be redacted at ingest.

Maya Lin: Can we commit to a demo next Tuesday: stream -> tool-call -> S3 sink? FastLane wants runbook + terraform snippet for IAM + IP ranges.

Nate (DevOps): Yes. I'll draft a runbook and a sample Terraform snippet for temporary IAM roles and short-lived creds. ETA: Friday EOD. Need FastLane technical contact and IP ranges.

Rina Gupta: I'll send preliminary pricing numbers by tomorrow 10am PT.

Owen Park: I'll prepare a tiny sample repo and a 3-min demo video for streaming flow.

Maya Lin: Perfect — I'll gather the questionnaire answers and hand off to Nate. Keeping this thread for coordination. :pray:
